plain_description.what: Putting uncertainty intervals on every reliability number of the per-subject model profiles. It reports how many questions per subject are needed for a reliable profile, and which of 14 MMLU-Pro subjects reach the reliability bar.
plain_description.why: Per-subject profiles are only trustworthy if their reliability is shown with intervals, not as point values.
plain_description.information: Result (no new calls): delivered. Physics and Math pass. Seven subjects pass only within their intervals. Engineering, Biology, Computer science, Economics and Health fail. The failing set is not simply the smallest subjects. At about 120-130 questions per subject, a per-subject deviation row cannot be certified. Later disclosure: the tree used for routing had about 6.7% of the routed questions visible during construction. It is on older judged data now ruled history.
